item.title: Coast Guard suspends search for people missing from fishing vessel that sank off Massachusetts
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard has announced that the search for survivors on a commercial fishing vessel that sank off the coast of Massachusetts with seven aboard has been suspended.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara 'changed how so many of us understand comedy and humanity'
item.description: Catherine O'Hara was never afraid to go big. Known for roles in "Schitt's Creek," "Beetlejuice," and "Home Alone," she made her lines and characters memorable.

item.title: Delaware basketball teams support mental health services in the 'SL24 Basketball Classic'
item.description: To honor the life and legacy of Sean Locke, Delaware basketball teams participated in a fundraising tournament.

item.title: Wreath-laying ceremony at Liberty Bell celebrates National Freedom Day
item.description: Each year, The National Freedom Day Association returns to the Liberty Bell with a wreath, recognizing the many steps it took for freedom to ring.

item.title: Free ice skating draws families to Penn's Landing despite frigid temperatures
item.description: PHILADELPHIA (WPVI) - Icy temperatures mirrored the rink itself at Penn's Landing on the final day of January, but that did not keep families away from a free ice skating event honoring America's 250th birthday.

item.title: AccuWeather: Cold continues for the start of February in the Philadelphia region
item.description: It turns windy Sunday as a nor'easter passes well offshore, with temperatures back near freezing by Monday.

item.title: 'Sanford and Son' star Demond Wilson dies at 79 after battle with cancer, son says
item.description: The entertainment world is mourning the loss of 70's TV star Demond Wilson, who was most known for his role opposite Redd Foxx in the hit series, "Sanford and Son."

item.title: Experience the 2026 Philadelphia Auto Show
item.description: Ducis Rodgers, Alicia Vitarelli, Gray Hall, and Karen Rogers host a special one-hour preview.

item.title: Community Gathers to Remember Victims of Deadly Northeast Philadelphia Jet Crash One Year Later
item.description: NORTHEAST PHILADELPHIA (WPVI) - It was a somber and emotional gathering in Northeast Philadelphia Saturday night as community members came together to mark one year since a deadly medical jet crash claimed eight lives.

item.title: Fans disappointed over 76ers' George 25-game drug suspension
item.description: Frustration and disappointment rippled through Philadelphia on Saturday as fans learned that 76ers star forward Paul George will miss the next 25 games.
